Reviewed startup performance claims against the implementation repair: service convergence and failed probes invalidate ownership; tray-only setup skips the early cover; successful PATH is cached while failures retry after a 30-second floor; identity refusal has its own code and dialog. Removed late server cache enablement after an isolated actual-bundle load probe produced no late cache entries; retained pre-load Desktop cache and scrubbed child env. Executed offline SourceMap mapping to index.ts; linked and true are equivalent esbuild modes. Focused tests cover PTY, CLI bundle, bridge and source routes; no packaged native runtime evidence is asserted.
